"''Fire.|Milon Lenwith and Chesille Sabrond|}} '''Chesille Sabrond''' was a [[human]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. She served as a [[captain]] in the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], and helmed the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Derriphan]]''. In [[35 ABY]], the ''Derriphan'' was the first [[Star Destroyer]] selected to leave Exegol, following orders from [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] of the [[First Order]] to [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroy]] the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== Chesille Sabrond was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[Unknown Regions]] [[planet]] [[Exegol]] in [[5 ABY]] and raised by the members of the [[Sith Eternal]] [[Religion|cult]], training her entire life in preparation for the launching of the [[Final Order]] being built on her [[homeworld]]. During her ascension among the [[Military rank|ranks]], she [[Death|killed]] three individuals, sabotaged two others, and barely [[Sleep|slept]] for over twenty [[Standard year|years]]. She eventually was made [[captain]] of the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Derriphan]]'' within the [[fleet]]. In [[35 ABY]], the leader of the [[Sith]] Eternal, the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]], made contact with the [[First Order]] and granted them use of the Sith fleet's resources in their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]]. ===Destruction of Kijimi=== {{Quote|Contact Imperial Command. Tell them the planet Kijimi is no more. Then set a course for our return to Exegol.|Chesille Sabrond|}} [[File:ChesilleSabrond-TROS.png|thumb|left|250px|Sabrond gives the order to fire on Kijimi.]] With First Order [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] now in control of the fleet, the ''Derriphan'' was the first of the Sith Eternal's ''Xyston''-class [[Star Destroyer]]s launched from Exegol. Under orders from Pryde, they traveled to the planet [[Kijimi]], which had recently harbored members of the Resistance, in order to make an example of the First Order's new might after their [[Kijimi garrison|garrison]] had been evacuated with [[Protocol 13]]. As the ''Derriphan'' approached its target, [[Lieutenant]] [[Milon Lenwith]] informed Sabrond on the Star Destroyer's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] that they were within range. The Sith Eternal officer immediately gave the order to fire the [[warship]]'s [[axial superlaser]], which [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] the entirety of Kijimi. Soon after this display of power, the ''Derriphan'' was sent back to Exegol, in where it battled against the Resistance in the [[Battle of Exegol]].{{Film|IX}} ===Battle of Exegol and death=== {{Dialogue|Fleet technician|Captain, we have Resistance craft incoming.|Chesille Sabrond|Allegiant General…|Enric Pryde|Use ion cannons!|attr=Sabrond is ordered to deploy ion cannons by Pryde|src=}} Sabrond remained on the ''Derriphan'' when the Resistance's [[Exegol air team|air team]] and [[Exegol landing team|landing team]] arrived from [[Ajan Kloss]]. As a [[Unidentified Sith Eternal fleet technician|fleet technician]] informed her of the Resistance's arrival, she was given orders from Pryde to fire [[ion cannon]]s at the Resistance. Eventually, the Resistance managed to get the upper hand with reinforcements, the [[Citizens' Fleet]].{{Databank|chewbacca|Chewbacca}}{{Databank|lando-calrissian|Lando Calrissian}} The Resistance then battled the Sith Star Destroyers, destroying the superlasers to bring down the warships. The ''Derriphan'' was eventually defeated and destroyed by the Resistance and the galaxy fleet, killing Sabrond. ==Personality and traits== [[File:CaptainSabrond-CEUEEd.png|thumb|180px|right|Captain Sabrond was an ambitious officer of the Final Order.]] Like all [[Youngling|children]] raised by the Sith Eternal [[Sith cultist|cultists]], Sabrond was raised to revere the power of the [[dark side of the Force]] despite not being able to use it. She was also taught the brutal "truth" of existence that might for might's sake is the ultimate end. Sabrond did not even value living things, as seen commanding fire towards [[Kijimi]] with utter coldness and inwardly feeling delight at the sight of the planet's destruction that made her wish to yell her triumph, although she suppressed such emotions in front of her crew due to such an act being unprofessional. Sabrond was an ambitious individual that sought the recognition of Darth Sidious and Allegiant General Enric Pryde, who she admired.''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' Taught by the Sith Eternal to believe that the galaxy was theirs by cosmic right, Sabrond was confident that she could stand out among the Final Order’s hundreds of captains, but Pryde thought of her as a mediocre captain that lacked any true potential, her Star Destroyer having been meant to be expendable cannon fodder. Sabrond was a [[human]] who stood 1.62 [[meter]]s (5 [[foot]], 4 inches) tall and had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Sabrond wore a black and red [[Sith Eternal uniform|Sith Eternal officer's uniform]] which included a black kepi [[hat]] with a Sith Eternal crest, black [[glove]]s and a black [[belt]] with a silver [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]]-style buckle containing an officer's disc. ==Behind the scenes== Chesille Sabrond was portrayed by [[Rochenda Sandall]] in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Screen Comix]] ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Chesille Sabrond}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Final Order and the Battle of Exegol}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Chesille Sabrond |fr=Chesille Sabrond |ja=チェジル・サブロンド |ka=ჩესილ სებრონდი |uk=Чесілл Сабронд }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Sabrond, Chesille}} [[Category:Captains]] [[Category:Exegol residents]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the Sith Eternal]]
